description: This file defines API routes for project management in a FastAPI backend, including create, read, update, and delete operations for projects.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router for defining project-related API endpoints.

methods.name: create_project( project_data: ProjectCreate, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_manager_or_admin_user) )
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new project, requires manager or admin role.

methods.name: get_projects(current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve all projects accessible to the current user.

methods.name: get_project( project_id: str, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Endpoint to get details of a project by its ID.

methods.name: update_project( project_id: str, project_data: ProjectUpdate, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_manager_or_admin_user) )
methods.description: Endpoint to update an existing project's details, requires manager or admin role.

methods.name: delete_project( project_id: str, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_manager_or_admin_user) )
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a project by its ID, requires manager or admin role.

ctags.name: update_project
ctags.signature: ( project_id: str, project_data: ProjectUpdate, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_manager_or_admin_user) )
